requirements.Additional_Comments_Information: Is there a reason to have 3 names for the same reference ? HP OJP 9010 All-in-one Printer series HP OJP 9010e All-in-One Printer series HP OJP 9010 All-in-One Printer Have too many names isn't efficient and can induce user errors
requirements.Threshold_Accept: two names / reference are proposed currently 4 references for Office Jet Pro 9010
requirements.Goal_Design_Target: Only one name / reference is proposed to customer
requirements.Remarks: Quality team is following-up with Tais Bellini. 20210702 (Chris/Jess) Not possible to change in 123.hp.com as it reference to Product Master List where is common shared with PC group. It is only currently possible to do at support.hp.com. Proposed to Drop.
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The Out-Of-Box Experience (OOBE) on 123.hp.com must present only one consistent product name/reference per printer model series to users, minimizing the possibility of user confusion due to multiple reference names.

requirements.Requirement: Printer able to run all new/current EM / market segment media
requirements.Additional_Comments_Information: Printer to meet intervention spec for the different media and climatic conditions for Manhattan platform.
requirements.Goal_Design_Target: Pass intervention rate and NO PQ issue
requirements.Remarks: 20220920(Sau Pin): LP2 Life test are meeting Intervention rate(Qual) 20220316 (Sau Pin): I assume baseline is same as Manhattan. Status as "Yellow" as need to review interventon performance. Accept threshold. EM media as Eval media.
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must reliably print on all new and current EM (Evaluation Media) and market segment media types, meeting minimum print quality (PQ) standards as defined by region and passing the intervention rate specification under all relevant climatic conditions for the Manhattan platform.

requirements.Requirement: Product can be placed and work on uneven surface ( sofa , table cloth , carpet …)
requirements.Additional_Comments_Information: As the complain on Vasari , input tray sensor flag broken when printer is placed on uneven surfact , this issue should be fixed in new product
requirements.Remarks: 20220315(Sau Pin): Marconi Base LP1 test with no issue reported. Marconi Hi and PDL SKUs testing on-going HDRV response: Have conducted sanity check with Manhattan Base & Hi, Malbec Hi and Agave. Only Malbec Hi had issue with input tray flag broken. Need TME input on field data for 3M.  Aiqiang: Manhattan field data shows tray "fang" broken. ME will look at solutions to solve fang broken issue such as to strengthen the fang.
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must operate reliably without hardware failures, including the input tray sensor flag, when placed and used on uneven surfaces such as sofas, table cloths, or carpets.

requirements.Requirement: Tilt left and right each while printing
requirements.Additional_Comments_Information: To assess whether there is any functional failure if customer tilt the printer during printing.(Sayan tilt left and right each at 20 degree while printing )
requirements.Remarks: tilt 20 degree is for CISS product as acknoledged by Michelle. Shin to check if want to evaluate on Manhattan Plus with XXL ink cartridges. Close for Marconi.
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer should be able to operate without functional failure if tilted left or right up to 20 degrees during printing, unless otherwise specified for a particular product line (e.g., CISS or Manhattan Plus).

requirements.Requirement: Put printer on trolley and print
requirements.Additional_Comments_Information: To check if there is PQ issue when printer print on trolley.
requirements.Remarks: (Sau Pin): Marconi Base LP1 test with no issue reported. Marconi Hi and PDL SKUs testing on-going interesting to find out the test result. HDRV response: Have conducted sanity check with Manhattan Base & Hi, Malbec Hi and Agave. No issue found. Agree to put it as evaluation. To be consistent with stardard UBT requirement.20220315
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must maintain print quality and operate normally when placed on a trolley and printing, consistent with standard User-Based Testing (UBT) requirements.
